outcome: Need for intensive care unit (ICU) admission and oxygen therapy
Symptoms of COVID-19 (high respiratory rate, low blood pressure, fever, cough, shortness of breath)
cohort: 33 pregnant women with confirmed COVID-19 infection admitted to King Fahd Hospital, Abu Arish General Hospital, and Sabya General Hospital, Jazan, Saudi Arabia
finding: COVID-19 infection during pregnancy was associated with significant maternal risks, including the need for ICU admission, oxygen therapy, and increased risk of maternal death, particularly in the third trimester.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was significantly associated with timing of infection and BMI.
